it.txt: Era vice-prefeita e assumiu a prefeitura em 04/04/2026, depois que Marcelo Maranata renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a governador na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: She was vice mayor and took over as mayor on April 4, 2026, after Mayor Marcelo Maranata resigned to run for governor in the 2026 election.
